com.zynthec.zLoader.name: zLoader
com.zynthec.zLoader.subtitle: Independent SideStore fork for iPhone and iPad.
com.zynthec.zLoader.localizedDescription: Sideloading and manage apps, deveoloper profiles and much more in zynthec style.
com.zynthec.zLoader.versionDescription: Pending installs share the installed-app grid and fill available row slots. Installed records are saved before completion and progress removal; database save failures are reported. Remaining validity includes the current partial day while retaining actual profile/extension/certificate expiry.
